coordinate_convention: Original chapter pixels [x0,y0,x1,y1], right and bottom exclusive.
annotation_limitations: Each region was visually inspected against original source context, not accepted because a PNG exported. These are provisional assistant manual annotations, not independently human-certified ground truth. Bounds use small safety margins; pale fades can have a few pixels of ambiguity. Whole chapter false positives and full chapter precision are not measurable from this selected set.
